purpose: Machine-checkable minimum contract for per-build JM routing manifests. It validates structure and explicit proof routing; it does not manufacture runtime/contact proof or crown a build.
laws: Declare the exact stack and true gaps before new capability creation.
Mesh does not mean merge; donor/source authority remains identifiable.
Built-ins are never bypassed to obtain green status.
A proof lane may only claim what its evidence actually proves.
A red Ding routes to the responsible organ; it does not justify rebuilding unrelated bodies.
Frozen keepers remain immutable; repairs correct forward.
Manual contact is escalation when native evidence is insufficient or the target contact surface itself must be proven.
Close only what is actually proven.
validator_boundary: A contract PASS means the manifest is structurally routable and explicit. It is not build/runtime/contact proof by itself.
